  static readonly INSTANCE = new TimerSignatureReminder();

  private constructor() {}

  readonly ELEMENT_ID = "timer_signatureReminder";
  readonly id = this.ELEMENT_ID;
  readonly elementType = "BOUNDARY_EVENT";
  readonly eventType = "TIMER";
  readonly name = "7 days passed";
  readonly timer = { type: "DURATION", timerValue: "P7D" } as const;
  readonly isInterrupting = false;

  get attachedTo(): SubProcessConcludeContract {
    return SubProcessConcludeContract.INSTANCE;
  }

  readonly next = {
    get serviceTaskSendReminderMail(): Runtime.SequenceFlows<ServiceTaskSendReminderMail> {
      return Runtime.sequenceFlows(ServiceTaskSendReminderMail.INSTANCE, { id: "flow_signatureReminderToSendReminderMail" });
    },
  };
}
